description: This file implements a Slack approval handler class for managing execution approval requests, including building approval messages, handling resolution and expiration, and updating Slack messages accordingly.

classes.name: SlackExecApprovalHandler
classes.description: A class managing Slack execution approval requests, including message creation, updates, and handling resolution/expiration events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SlackExecApprovalHandler with configuration options and sets up the runtime.

methods.name: shouldHandle
methods.description: Determines if a given approval request should be handled by this handler.

methods.name: finalizeResolved
methods.description: Updates messages to reflect a resolved approval.

methods.name: finalizeExpired
methods.description: Updates messages to reflect an expired approval.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Updates a Slack message with new content.
